changes.summary: On this "Face the Nation with Margaret Brennan" broadcast, Republican Sen. Tim Scott remembers Lindsey Graham, and Israeli Ambassador Michael Leiter and retired Gen. Frank McKenzie discuss the Iran war.

changes.title: Oil Rises After Weekend of Back-and-Forth Strikes by U.S. and Iran
changes.summary: The renewed hostilities posed fresh risks to ships seeking to navigate the Strait of Hormuz.

changes.title: Politics chat: Lindsey Graham dies at 71, Congress back in session, U.S. strikes Iran
changes.summary: South Carolina Senator Lindsey Graham's sudden death at 71 has shocked Washington. Once a fierce critic of then-candidate Donald Trump, he became one of the president's most consistent defenders.

changes.title: Trump Sought an Iran War Exit. Putin Pushed On in Ukraine. Now Both Are Stuck.
changes.summary: The Iran and Ukraine wars underline the common limits of military force in achieving political ends, but also the differences between a dug-in Russian president and a vacillating American one.

changes.title: Adam Schiff remembers Lindsey Graham as ‘larger than life’: Full interview
changes.summary: Sen. Adam Schiff (D-Calif.) joins Meet the Press to reflect on the passing of his colleague Sen. Lindsey Graham (R-S.C.) and discuss the U.S. war with Iran as both countries continue to trade strikes.

changes.title: Iran reports new attacks on military targets on its largest island near the Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: Iran's state-run IRNA news agency cited the governor of Qeshm island near the strait as saying projectiles had been fired at military targets, with no casualties.

changes.title: Lindsey Graham Championed Israel, Even as Wars Eroded American Support
changes.summary: The Republican senator from South Carolina had an intense interest in the Middle East, and was a staunch supporter of U.S. strikes on Iran.

changes.title: Hard-Liners in Iran Want to Keep Fighting America
changes.summary: With much of their leadership killed in the war, Iran’s conservatives have sought to fill the void and intensify the fight against the United States.

changes.title: U.S. and Iran trade airstrikes again amid conflicting claims over Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: The U.S. and Iran exchanged a barrage of missile and drone airstrikes amid a dispute over the status of the Strait of Hormuz.
